name: Lord of Atlantis
description: A giant merfolk considered a sea god, who met Greensleeves at Lat-Nam in 4077 AR.

description_citations.text: "Mina". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves to the College, where she learns the Stone Brain's true nature.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves was then taken underwater by the Lord of Atlantis

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves to the underwater College, where she asks a Sage's skull the secret of the Stone Brain.
timeline.quote: Greensleeves finds a skull of a Sage, to which she asks the secret of the Stone Brain.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of Atlantis takes Greensleeves underwater where she asks a Sage's skull for the Stone Brain's secret.
timeline.quote: She mentally asked the skull for the secret of the Stone Brain.

citation.text: "Greensleeves", section "Final sacrifice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
